item.title: Analysts say Gaza 'civilian' deaths include Hamas, other terror members working as medics, media workers
item.summary: Researchers say Hamas and PIJ martyr lists reveal Gaza terrorists who posed as doctors, nurses and journalists, clouding civilian casualty figures.

item.title: Unpaid DHS workers ‘distracted’ as terror threats rise, fueling airport security concerns
item.summary: Chad Wolf warns unpaid DHS workers are "distracted" amid rising terror threats, as the government shutdown strains TSA operations at major airports.

item.title: Alabama student’s death leads ex-detective to reveal how investigators probe possible drugging cases
item.summary: Authorities have not ruled out drugging after University of Alabama student Jimmy Gracey was found dead in Barcelona's waters near Port Olímpic area.

item.title: Trump mocks 'discombobulated' Schumer over Democrats' near gaffe on funding ICE
item.summary: President Donald Trump mocked Chuck Schumer after the Senate minority leader accidentally said "We must fund ICE" on the Senate floor amid the DHS funding shutdown fight.

item.title: Far-left activists stay in 5-star Cuban hotel as island suffers total blackout
item.summary: CodePink sponsored flights to Cuba to protest President Donald Trump's sanctions, but the group faced backlash for staying in luxury hotels.

item.title: Man pulls off extreme 8-hour trip to another country, flies home same day
item.summary: A 28-year-old NYC content creator flew to Jamaica and back in just eight hours, hitting a waterfall, eating jerk chicken, and spending only $382.

item.title: William Shatner turns 95 and gives blunt life advice that keeps him 'smokin'!'
item.summary: William Shatner celebrated his 95th birthday with a witty tweet, saying he's "still smokin'" and sharing advice about cigars and never acting your age.

item.title: California sheriff seizes 650,000 ballots in defiance of state officials over election count dispute
item.summary: Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco seized over 650,000 ballots to probe alleged excess votes in California's Proposition 50 special election.

item.title: Maddow rebukes Robert Mueller’s legacy as 'wildly outmaneuvered' following his death at 81
item.summary: Rachel Maddow said Robert Mueller was "wildly outmaneuvered" by Bill Barr after his death at 81 on Saturday, and said that weighed heaviest on his legacy.

item.title: Texas parents flood school choice program, far exceeding the initial 90,000 student capacity
item.summary: Texas school choice applications for the Texas Education Freedom Accounts surpassed 241,000, far exceeding the 90,000 spots funded by the program's initial $1 billion investment.
